svg.title: HiveRelay Core3 architecture graph
svg.desc: A detailed graph of HiveRelay Core3 actors, live consumers including PearBrowser, PearPaste, and anonGPT, ingress APIs, HyperDHT and Hyperswarm transports, Protomux channels, compact-encoding schemas, relay kernel modules, opt-in services, evidence contracts, security boundaries, and live release distribution to fleet, Umbrel, and StartOS.
svg.text: P2P relay backbone for PearBrowser, PearPaste, anonGPT, browser gateways, blind custody, service RPC, verifiable schemas, and live fleet/app-store releases.
Consumer audit keeps PearBrowser desktop, PearPaste, anonGPT, and other direct p2p-hiverelay* packages on npm latest after registry proof.
intent -> receipt -> commit -> proof; ciphertext-only storage
field allowlists reject plaintext, key material, private filenames
access control, policy guard, swarm firewall, alerts, eviction
All channel frames use Protomux plus compact-encoding.
Decoders bound declared lengths before allocation.
Atomic writes use tmp-file plus rename for critical service, custody, and release state.

text.tspan: full release defaults to both -> fleet health
